headline: HOLD: 1 blocker and 6 non-mutuality issues require us to renegotiate.

findings.title: Restriction in this contract hits current clients: PayTrack Technologies, Trustline NBFC, FinEdge Bank
findings.impact: Restricts AtliQ from providing data analytics and reporting services to fintechs, NBFCs, and banks in India, which directly impacts active clients PayTrack Technologies and Trustline NBFC, as well as pipeline prospect FinEdge Bank.

2.1 "**Confidential Information**" means all non-public information disclosed by a Party (the "**Disclosing Party**") to the other Party (the "**Receiving Party**") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked or identified as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential, including system architecture, security documentation, pricing, proposals, methodologies, source code and business plans.

2.2 Confidential Information does not include information that the Receiving Party can demonstrate (a) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully known to it before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

2.3 **Protected Health Information.** Protected Health Information, as defined at 45 C.F.R. § 160.103, is excluded from this Agreement and shall be disclosed only after execution of a Business Associate Agreement between the Parties. hits.heading: RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
12.1 In consideration of the Client disclosing to the Supplier its Confidential Information, including its revenue strategies, pricing models and Guest Data, the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
12.2 For the purposes of Clause 12.1, services are provided "in the GCC" if the Hospitality Business receiving them is headquartered in, or the services relate to properties or operations located in, any state of the GCC, irrespective of where the services are performed.
12.3 The Supplier shall procure that each of its Affiliates complies with this Clause 12 as if it were a party to this Agreement, and any breach by an Affiliate shall be deemed a breach by the Supplier.
12.4 The Client may, in its sole discretion, waive the restriction in Clause 12.1 in respect of a specific engagement by written consent signed by an authorised signatory of the Client. Any such waiver shall be limited to its express terms.
12.5 During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party who was directly involved in the Services, save through general advertisements not targeted at such employees.

hits.heading: EXCLUSIVITY
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
7.1 In consideration of the Referral Fees, market development funds and other benefits under this Agreement, during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.

7.2 "**Competing Platform**" means any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform offered as a service.

7.3 For clarity, Clause 7.1 does not restrict Partner or its Affiliates from (a) providing services outside India and the GCC; or (b) providing services to a customer that has independently selected a platform, provided Partner does not hold a partner appointment with, or receive any fee or benefit from, the provider of that platform.

7.4 In this Clause 7, "GCC" has the meaning given to the member states listed in the definition of Territory.
